description_en: Redeploys the published versions of a task flow
description_zh: 调用ReDeployLhDagVersion接口，重新部署任务流历史版本
name: ReDeployLhDagVersion

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task flow. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html operation to obtain the ID of the task flow
parameters.help_zh: 任务流ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: dag_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task flow version. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424682.html operation to obtain the ID of the task flow version
parameters.help_zh: 任务流版本ID（VersionId），可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424682.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: dag_version

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html operation to obtain the ID of the tenant
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: tid
